title: WorldOnline
tagline: An application which helps mark attendance for employees in an office.
description: An application built using World Network's tooling which helps mark attendance for employees in an office. To perform a liveness check, we are using WorldOnline to allow people mark their attendance live. This will ensure fairness, liveness, uniqueness and also help the managers to regulate things properly.
